browserSearchPath: CLMS Bio-geophysical Parameters, Vegetation, Net/Gross Primary Production
collectionDescription: Gross Primary Production (GPP), expressed in gC/m²/day, measures the total carbon fixed by plants through photosynthesis at ecosystem level — the gross carbon input from which the net production (NPP) is obtained after subtracting plant respiration. Global GPP estimates are available every 10 days at a spatial resolution of roughly 300 m, from January 2014 onwards.

layers.longDescription: Gross Primary Production (GPP) represents the total amount of carbon fixed by plants through photosynthesis in an ecosystem, expressed in gC/m²/day.

layers.shortDescription: Quality Flag of the Gross Primary Production
layers.longDescription: The quality flag (QFLAG) summarises, for each pixel, the conditions under which the Gross Primary Production value was produced — for instance whether the input FAPAR or meteorological data were missing, whether the pixel is evergreen broadleaf forest, or whether the fAPAR value was rescaled, filled from the previous dekad or interpolated — enabling users to filter the dataset according to their quality requirements.
